description: Dependency updates as pull requests, tested by the CI (docs/development.md#dependency-updates).

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Development tools in one pull request, merged automatically when the tests are green.
GitHub Actions and gitleaks: minor and patch updates merged automatically when the tests are green.

MariaDB of the CI: Renovate cannot tell LTS from short-term releases, so updates wait for approval in the Dependency Dashboard (approve only a new LTS line; closing a major pull request would ignore the whole major version).
MariaDB 10.11 is the lowest supported version (Debian 12) and stays until that promise changes.
The PHP constraint states the lowest supported version and is changed by hand.

customManagers.description: Version of gitleaks in the secret scan job and the MariaDB versions of the test matrix.
